LanguageData.WotF_ForestCraft.description: An artisan's instinct favoring bare hands and arcane tools. Elves work with remarkable ease at unpowered benches, producing higher-quality goods, yet grow somewhat clumsy around powered modern machinery. When fixing broken electrical devices, their strange gestures look less like repair than soothing the machine—though somehow it works.
